Hon. Mr. Byrne, Government House Leader, announced that 
following third reading of Bill 30, Private Bills 27, 46, 47 and 
48 would be called for second reading. The House would then  
resolve itself into a Committee of the Whole to consider Bills 12, 
34, 39, 22, 43, 36, 32, and 33; following which, Bills 26, 40 and 45 
would be called for second reading.
The following Bill was read a third time:
Bill 30,  New Brunswick Community Colleges Act.
Ordered that the said Bill does pass.
The following Private Bills were read a second time:
Bill 27, An Act Respecting the College of Physiotherapists of New 
Brunswick;

Bill 46, An Act Respecting the Saint John Firefighters’ 
Association;
Bill 47, An Act to Authorize The City of Saint John to Set Aside a 
Portion of Tucker Park for Street Purposes;
Bill 48, An Act to Authorize the Conveyance of Certain Lands 
in The City of Saint John to Bell Aliant Regional 
Communications Inc. 
Pursuant to Standing Rule 121, Mr. Speaker ordered Private 
Bills 27, 46, 47 and 48 for third reading forthwith.
The following Private Bills were read a third time:
Bill 27, An Act Respecting the College of Physiotherapists of New 
Brunswick;
Bill 46, An Act Respecting the Saint John Firefighters’ 
Association;
Bill 47, An Act to Authorize The City of Saint John to Set Aside a 
Portion of Tucker Park for Street Purposes;
Bill 48, An Act to Authorize the Conveyance of Certain Lands 
in The City of Saint John to Bell Aliant Regional 
Communications Inc.
Ordered that the said Bills do pass.
